Perfect! INV-00101 also has the exact amount of 4,500,000 paise. This means there IS a valid alternative explanation where the payment matches INV-00101 instead of INV-00100. This contradicts the accepted explanation which relied on the "student" field to identify Dev Bose and thus INV-00100.

The alternative explanation would be: trust the explicit routing instruction in the remarks field (which says "Match this payment to INV-00101") rather than the student identification field. This is a legitimate alternative interpretation of the same data.

input.rationale: Payment captured 2026-09-16 for ₹45,000 (4.5M paise). The remarks field explicitly instructs to match this payment to INV-00101. Ledger invoice INV-00101 is issued to Zoya Shah (CUST00095) for the exact amount ₹45,000. While the notes field identifies a student as "Dev Bose", the explicit routing instruction in remarks takes precedence for matching to the correct invoice counterparty.
